clientAndSpanSummary.aggregation: Median of five per-run statistics for each runtime; no pooled-request percentile and no raw clock-origin subtraction

limits: Windows include request warmup and sampler/guard edges, not exact measured1000-only intervals.
Sampled maxima are observed values, not exact peaks; missing fields are null, never zero.
Pool ordinals are local to one variant and do not identify a pool across variants.
Npgsql operation histogram observations are not SQL statement counts or pool-wait durations.
Missing pending/timeout metrics and zero sampled queues do not prove no wait occurred.
Endpoint counter deltas are withheld when fewer than two observations or a decrease was observed.
Server process counters include background work and metric scrapes; CPU/GC attribution is not per request.

postgresInterpretation: Activity buckets use a requested100ms interval; they are not continuous exact backend maxima or time-weighted utilization.
Database counters can lag and include background Wolverine, readiness, metrics and maintenance activity; their deltas are not exact statement or request counts.
Idle ClientRead denotes PostgreSQL waiting for a client; no database-client pool-wait attribution can be made from these views.
No statement text, parameters, usernames, client addresses, connection strings or pool-name tags are read or retained.
Discarded warmup variants are separate from the five recorded pairs.
retention: Full raw frames, traces, images and scripts are task-local ignored artifacts; this committed summary is an inspection record, not a relocatable qualification bundle.
